title: Musical Instrument Museum Self-Guided Tour Ticket in Phoenix
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Children must be accompanied by an adult
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
The Musical Instrument Museum (MIM) offers a one-of-a-kind experience that can only be found in Phoenix. With more than 4,200 instruments on display, MIM showcases music and cultures from every country in the world through engaging exhibits and state-of-the-art audio and video technology. In MIM’s Artist Gallery, get a close-up look at instruments played by influential artists, such as Prince, Madonna, Ravi Shankar, Johnny Cash, Roberta Flack, Tito Puente, Celia Cruz, Glen Campbell, and many more. And finally, make some music of your own in the Experience Gallery!

MIM’s Café Allegro offers delicious global cuisine, and the award-winning Museum Store includes an array of creative, global, and music-inspired gifts.
